label: PRIOR_4 well-founded among actual concreta, from grounding well-founded on them
description: Non-transcription conditional derivation on one grounding profile m, one world w and one being-without relation CanBeWithout. If grounding among actual concreta at w is well-founded (82cfaf26) and, between actual concreta at w, what is PRIOR_4 to the other grounds it (the PRIOR_4 bridge), then PRIOR_4 among the actual concreta at w is well-founded. Unlike simplePriorityWFOfActualGroundingWF (#1942, PRIOR_1) it needs no irreflexivity premise, because PRIOR_4 is asymmetric by definition, and its bridge is not touched by the hand-and-stick case or by an absent or abstract prior thing. So PRIOR_4 among actual concreta joins the one dependence order. It does not reach d85de8e1 or its consumers: priorityConsumerLimit is a Bool interpretation in which actual grounding, the PRIOR_4 bridge, PRIOR_4 well-founded among actual concreta and on the whole carrier hold, the inputs of e229bb2c (57552dce, e078f07b) and 32d77f18 hold, while PRIOR_1 (d85de8e1) and the causal predecessors (42890b45) are not well-founded and 86efed1a fails; there the PRIOR_4 reading of e078f07b's shape fails, a PRIOR_1 pair is not PRIOR_4 and (last conjunct) a PRIOR_4 pair is not PRIOR_1. priorityInBeingControls drop each input on Nat (PRIOR_4 is asymmetric, so an infinite ascent replaces the two-cycle) and give a nonvacuous Bool interpretation. Facts about these interpretations only.
